definitions.explanation: An attack or invasion by an outside force, historically referring to military incursions. Also used for natural disasters or phenomena that strike with force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{襲来|しゅうらい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襲来|しゅうらい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{防備|ぼうび}→防備：24094_boubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{固|かた}めた→固める：01929_katameru⟧。
examples.english: They strengthened their defenses in preparation for an enemy attack.

examples.japanese: {元|げん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襲来|しゅうらい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦における→〜における：21802_niokeru⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The Mongol invasions are one of the important events in Japanese history.

notes:
USAGE:
{襲来|しゅうらい} implies something coming at you with force from outside. It is commonly used for natural disasters (⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襲来|しゅうらい}, ⟦{寒波|かんぱ}→寒波：12354_kanpa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襲来|しゅうらい}) and historical military invasions. The word carries a dramatic, forceful tone. Historically, {元寇|げんこう} (the Mongol invasions of Japan) are often described using this word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襲来|しゅうらい}: a typhoon striking
- ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襲来|しゅうらい}: enemy attack/invasion
- ⟦{寒波|かんぱ}→寒波：12354_kanpa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襲来|しゅうらい}: onset of a cold wave
- {襲来|しゅうらい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare for an onslaught
